basic_info.description: Beautiful newly remodeled spacious Edwardian with lots of original detail including gumwood paneling, double inlaid hardwood floors, 10 foot ceilings and crown molding. This property was cmpletely gutted and remodeled 10 years ago while keeping the charm and period details. Walk to Golden Gate Park whhich is one block away.  Visit the DeYoung museum, Academy of Sciences, Japanese Tea Garden or Rose Garden.  Updates include electrical, plumbing, Sonos surround sound and surveillance system.  Huge master bedroom with his and her walk in closets.  The ground floor is brand new construction as of 2015.  Access the low maintenance backyard from either the ground floor or through the second floor attached newly stained deck with steps to the backyard.  The backyard features artificial turf with beautiful succulents on the perimeter.  Kitchen areas have stainless steel appliances and all appliances are less than 10 years old.  Dryer is approximately 2 years old.  Collect extra income from tenants in inlaw unit on ground floor.  All work done with permits but not as a legal second unit.  Buyer to cooperate in a 1031 exchange.
